descriptionChirho: Purple cloth or dye (אַרְגָּמָן), a costly textile dyed with murex-derived pigment, used extensively in tabernacle/temple furnishings and royal garments. Multilingual evidence is uniform: eng 'purple', spa 'púrpura', hin 'बैंगनी', arb 'أُرْجُوَان', kor '자주색', swa 'zambarau'. The two clusters differ only in the presence or absence of conjunction waw, the article, and construct-state morphology — purely grammatical variation with no semantic distinction between the 35-occurrence and 3-occurrence groups.
